name: source analysis pipeline
rules: Keep source identity, parser or analyzer version, facts, artifacts, unresolved references and completeness state explicit.
Separate raw source observations from normalized facts, projections, reports and hypotheses.
Treat analyzer failure or unavailable input as an explicit diagnostic, not as missing or successful evidence.
verification: Review ingestion, fact normalization, artifact identity and unresolved-reference handling.
Test malformed, incomplete, unsupported and repeated source inputs with deterministic evidence.
